task: Detect when a story's frozen checklist userSees claim has drifted from the delivered code and surface it as an advisory, instead of silently trusting a stale promise (Phase 1 of 2: detect + report, non-blocking).
outcome:
Running `node bin/lattice.js frozen_claim_drift_check --storyId=B-XXXX` on a story whose userSees drifted prints:

FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT advisory for B-XXXX (2 drifted, 1 legacy-unbound, non-blocking)
  CHK-002:userSees  driftKind=material  actionRequired=re_attestation
    prevMaterialHash a1b2c3d... -> currMaterialHash 9f8e7d...
  CHK-003:userSees  driftKind=claim     actionRequired=re_attestation
    prevDigest 4d5e6f... -> currDigest 7a8b9c...
  CHK-001:userSees  classification=legacy-unbound (no snapshot; not counted as drift)
advisory only -- no gate blocked; re-attestation lands in Phase 2

On a clean story the same command prints:
  FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT advisory for B-XXXX: 0 drifted, 0 legacy-unbound -- clean
and exits 0. `node bin/lattice.js validate` runs the frozen-claim-drift smoke and reports it green among the validate commands.
facts: M1 (Milestone 1 = tool-executed evidence receipts, spec section 1) shipped as B-ec67 at CLI 0.3.240: enforceAndStampEvidence (packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:497) runs a pinned command and stamps VerificationExecutionReceipt (packages/main/src/core/types.ts:690), bound to headHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash.

B-1507 re-execution (writeStaleRefresh, checklist.ts:818) demotes a stale mechanical receipt to a non-mechanical attestation unless the pinned command is re-run and passes -- it never launders a stale pass onto new material.

B-5a9a added storyFilesHash (a story-diff-scoped hash) so unrelated main merges stop staling a story's bindings; B-d243/B-edf1 surface a signed storyFilesHash whole-tree-drift re-attestation advisory on the delivery-check / DONE gate. This is the exact freshness+advisory machinery this story extends.
A checklist item's userSees is descriptive prose today with NO evidence binding; nothing re-checks it after code changes (the F-027/F-060 gap).
F-027/F-060 = userSees frozen-field drift; F-059 = plan.md claim drift. Spec section 5 flags both as the same super-class as class 1 and as an orphaned follow-on, unblocked once M1 exists.
In both source incidents the claim text stayed static while the underlying code/evidence moved, so a claim-text digest alone catches neither.

B-7813 (merged) handles ONLY the declare-unreachable case: on stall it withdraws the checklist item plus a separate acceptanceBindings proof-story artifact; it does NOT rewrite plan.md DoneWhen/Verify prose. General plan.md drift is therefore still unowned and is deferred to Phase 2 (INIT-001 precision).
review_incremental_context already computes a rename-aware material diff (git diff --name-status -M) that this story mirrors for the material-drift signal.
constraints: Normalization must be purely mechanical and deterministic (trim + collapse internal whitespace + strip trailing); NO semantic or LLM diffing -- that is the primary false-positive engine and is non-reproducible.

Phase 1 must be NON-blocking: no existing gate (review guard, delivery-check, DONE) may begin failing on drift, because no re-attestation recovery path exists until Phase 2 and a block would wedge stories.
Pre-existing userSees with no snapshot must be classified legacy-unbound and reported, never errored (grandfather; do not break active or DONE stories).

Handler runtime-revalidation convention (CLAUDE.md): every Zod min/max/enum constraint is re-checked at runtime at each consumer (handler entry + every gate/fn/serializer that reads the field), not only at the schema boundary.
All story mutations via the lattice CLI; no direct docs/story or .lattice file edits. Snapshot capture must be immutable-once (mirror the B-ec67 pin-once model), never re-snapshotted on read.
Reuse existing freshness primitives (currentMaterialHash / currentStoryFilesHash / checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit in checklist.ts); do not build a parallel drift model.
unknowns: Exact attestation hook where the userSees snapshot is captured (DEV spike, does not change the checklist split): candidate is checklist_update when status transitions to done; must be verified against the checklist_update handler so the snapshot is taken at delivery, exactly once, and is never re-taken on later reads.
Advisory surface: a standalone read-only command (frozen_claim_drift_check), a story_get projection, or both -- leaning standalone command with an optional story_get field; low-risk DEV choice.
touchpoints: packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts (snapshot capture hook at status=done; reuse freshness primitives)
packages/main/src/core/frozen-claim-drift.ts (new pure fn: normalizeClaim, claimDigest, detectDrift -- no I/O)
